narrative.overview: Carbon (2026-11-18, replaced the cool-neutral-plus-teal look): true neutral greys, a near-white (dark) or near-black (light) accent, colour only for meaning: amber waits, red is danger, green is ok or connected, plus the host tile hues. A calm cool-neutral app with one teal accent (history). The shell (a full-width top bar and a left sidebar) is one neutral step off the work area and a 1 px Divider, not a colour block. Everything is quiet grey, so the few things that ask for a decision stand out: an amber Auto chip on a host the AI may run on without a click, a filled red Deny, a red edge on a SUDO request. The cool neutral replaced the warm-neutral-plus-teal-shell look on 2026-11-17 at the author's request.
keyCharacteristics: A neutral shell (rail) one step off the work area; the accent is neutral (carbon, 2026-11-18). The terminal and Files yield the sidebar.
Three surface steps, two shadows, three radii.
Filled letter tiles, each host its own hue (never green, which is the connected tile). Grant ring removed 2026-11-17 at the author's request; the chip carries the grant.
System font; monospace only for what is literal.
Decisions are slow on purpose: Allow is outline and mouse-only, Cancel is the filled default.

rules.name: The State-Not-Style Rule
rules.body: Colour is for meaning (carbon, 2026-11-18). Green, amber and red each mean one thing and are never used for decoration.

rules.name: The Shell Stays Shell Rule
rules.body: Rail and Rail Text appear only on the top bar and sidebar; the shell never takes a hue.

rules.name: The Full-Strength Tint Rule
rules.body: Chips and banners use the tint colour at full strength with the matching hue as text.

rules.name: The Literal-Only Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks text the user may have to copy or compare exactly.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is bold or Muted. There is no display size.

rules.name: The Two-Shadows Rule
rules.body: Card and Raised are the whole vocabulary.

rules.name: The Border-Plus-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card also has a 1 px Line border so it reads in dark.

dos: Do read every colour from tok(c) / palette(dark); add a new pair to palette_test.go before using it (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI).
Do make Deny the filled, default, keyboard-reachable button and Allow an outline that waits 500 ms and takes a mouse click.
Do make Cancel the filled primary with AutoFocus in any dialog that has a risky action.
Do show a request's command, stdin, paths and addresses in monospace on the Terminal colours with a Line outline.
Do put banners in the work column, not in the AI column.
Do use 6 / 10 / 14 radii, the two shadows, and the Bg / Surface / Raised steps.
Do keep terminal-resizing layout changes instant (snap), never animated.
donts: Don't animate the sidebar or AI column width, or anything that moves a decision button or resizes a terminal.
Don't call the hub from an animation, timer or autoAllow notification; the app polls only status.
Don't use Rail or Rail Text outside the top bar and sidebar, or give the shell a hue.
Don't put a monospace face on labels, buttons or prose.
Don't write a raw colour or add a third shadow.
Don't make Allow, Trust, Enable, Resume, Overwrite all, Skip existing or Delete easier than their safe counterpart.
